title: Destiny 2 Content Unvaulting Won't Take Place Until 2028
summary:
Bungie needs 12 months for production and porting.

PlayStation developer Bungie has confirmed it'll likely need until the first few months of 2028 to complete the unvaulting process of old Destiny 2 content it recently promised to bring back.

A new community update post shares a predicted timeline for the content unvault, with the studio currently at the pre-production stage. It expects to be at this point until January or February of next year, and then it'll enter full production for about 12 months, placing a finish line at the beginning of 2028. "It's a lot of content," said Bungie.

title: PS5 Still Outselling PS4 in USA Despite Much Higher Price and Fewer Exclusives
summary:
Selling better by 1% lifetime to date.

Even though it costs an arm and a leg, and it has far fewer exclusive games, the PS5 continues to outsell the PS4 in the USA when you compare the same point in their lifespans.

Via analyst Mat Piscatella of Circana, we're currently in the 71st month of the PS5 generation. When you compare total sales in the USA to the same month of the PS4 generation, the PS5 is outselling the PS4 by 1%. It is also outselling the PS3 at the same point in the USA by 30%.
